items.title: DevFest Ilorin 2026
items.text:
Date: 6 November 2026, 07:00 UTC
Ends: 7 November 2026, 16:00 UTC
Location: Ilorin Innovation Hub, 9a Ahmadu Bello Way
Registration: Free registration

Join us on November 6th for the DevFest Ilorin 2026 Kickoff Meetup!
Get ready for an engaging session with local experts who will share insights and trends shaping the future of the web.
This is your chance to connect with fellow developers, tech enthusiasts, and innovators in Ilorin. RSVP now and be part of something amazing as we set the stage for Devfest Ilorin 2026!
